'''Galpos II''' was a desolate<ref name="SWR">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was suspected to be a base for [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] groups operating in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="SWR" /> The pirate vessel ''[[GrimDeath I]]'' was once tracked traveling to the world.<ref name="Briefing">{{WEGCite|story=The Briefing of Spacetrooper Platoon 243-XT|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Galpos II's entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' placed the planet in the [[Woldona system/Legends|Woldona system]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|317|Galpos II}}</ref> However, the publication of the [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] places the Galpos and Woldona systems in different sectors.
